records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Vantage Labs set up
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Vantage Labs* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone despite welcome email (email:baa7a775), nurture (email:4c80bbde) and a held onboarding call (calendar:f606de72). Zero customer replies or tickets signals low engagement; solo Starter admin. 8 days left, so some chance of self-serve start.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for making time for the getting started call last week. Since then I haven't seen a first project in your Wrenfield account, so I wanted to check in.

Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one is the natural first step. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Priya
